executiveSummary: CISA warns of active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs (S7-200/300/400/1200/1500) using scanning and S7comm write operations; immediate removal of internet exposure and strict blocking of TCP/102 is advised. Security Advisory OT gateways face elevated risk: multiple unauthenticated RCE/missing-auth flaws affect Advantech EKI-1242 (OPC UA/edge gateway) and WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways; patch and segment immediately. Supporting Report Supporting Report Perimeter edge devices are being actively exploited: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway and Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities are under attack, enabling initial access and lateral movement toward OT networks. Security Advisory KEV Notice Ransomware risk is elevated. Joint #StopRansomware advisories detail Gunra and SafePay operations abusing VPNs and edge systems; enforce MFA, segmentation, and immutable backups. Gunra Advisory SafePay Advisory Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) was mass-exploited with WAF-evasion via URL-encoding, impacting government and transportation; prioritize patching and hunt for past exploitation. View Article A critical Linux TCP/IP race (CVE-2026-98432) with remote code execution affects many kernels used in embedded/industrial appliances; patch kernels and disable MPTCP where not required. View Article "PHP2Shell" unauthenticated RCE in PHP is actively abused across internet-facing portals; immediate upgrades and webshell hunting are required for IT/OT DMZ web tiers. CISA Alert Vendor Advisory OT vendor advisories of note: EPICS Base (control framework) released fixes; Hitachi Energy TRO600 industrial routers contain high-severity issues exposing credentials and internal services; Mendix SAML and CoreTec advisories also updated. EPICS ICSA TRO600 ICSA State-linked intrusion activity persists: China-nexus botnet-based pre-positioning in critical infrastructure environments and a Lazarus campaign with multi-stage loaders emphasize defense-in-depth and egress control. Joint Advisory Research Report

sectors: Energy: OT routers (TRO600), gateways (EKI), PLC targeting (S7), ICS frameworks (EPICS Base). Water and Wastewater Systems: PLC targeting (S7), gateway/DMZ exposure, ransomware lateral movement. Critical Manufacturing: PLCs/OPC UA gateways, enterprise/edge exploitation (NetScaler/Ivanti). Government Services and Facilities: PeopleSoft exploitation; edge device intrusions. Telecommunications/IT Services: VPN/ADC exploitation; PHP RCE on portals. Transportation/Aviation: PeopleSoft-related intrusions and potential identity theft risks.

items: China-nexus covert networks leveraging SOHO/IoT devices to pre-position in CI environments; prioritize router hygiene and strict egress controls. Joint Advisory
Lazarus "Operation FlashHole" uses multi-stage loaders, DLL hijacking, and cloud-service C2 (GitHub/Dropbox); harden developer endpoints and DLL search order. Research Report
ShinyHunters mass-exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft with WAF-evasion; confirms sophisticated web exploitation across government and transportation. View Article
Ransomware playbooks (Gunra, SafePay) feature edge exploitation, LOTL (PsExec/WinRM), cloud exfil (Mega/OneDrive), and VSS deletion-consistent with past CI disruptions. Gunra SafePay

relevance: Threat activity this cycle concentrates on initial access via edge appliances (VPN/ADC), mass exploitation of ubiquitous web stacks (PHP), and targeted reconnaissance or manipulation of ICS assets (Siemens S7). Several ICS-specific advisories (EPICS Base, TRO600 routers, Advantech gateways) raise the probability of device-level impact in Energy, Water/Wastewater, and Critical Manufacturing. Active ransomware operations rely on the same ingress vectors and lateral movement techniques that traverse IT-OT boundaries when segmentation is weak. In practical terms, the highest near-term risk to operations stems from: (1) exploited edge devices enabling enterprise compromise and jump-host abuse; (2) OT gateways with missing authentication or arbitrary file read/write leading to credential theft and pivoting; and (3) direct PLC targeting over S7comm in poorly segmented networks. Rapid patching, isolation of management planes, and detection focused on appliance/web tier compromise provide the greatest marginal risk reduction for the next 72 hours.

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190) - PHP RCE, Oracle PeopleSoft, NetScaler/Ivanti vulns.
Persistence: Web Shell (T1505.003) on web tiers and appliances; application-specific passwords (Zimbra campaign).
Lateral Movement: Remote Services (T1021) via RDP/WinRM/PsExec; abuse of VPN/VDI portals.
Credential Access: OS Credential Dumping (T1003); device credential exposure (TRO600).
Defense Evasion: Living-off-the-land (PowerShell/WMI), URL encoding to evade WAF rules.
Collection/Exfiltration: Exfil via Cloud Services (T1567.002) to OneDrive/Mega/GitHub/Dropbox; DNS tunneling (Zimbra campaign).
Impact: Encryption for Impact (T1486) - ransomware (Gunra, SafePay); ICS manipulation risk via S7comm writes.

outlook72h: Expect continued scanning/exploitation for PHP RCE and edge devices (NetScaler/Ivanti) with automated webshell deployment and credential theft. Likely uptick in probes against Siemens S7/TCP-102; verify perimeters block S7comm and monitor for unauthorized writes. Emergency patch cycles for Linux kernel MPTCP RCE and OT gateways may cause change activity on perimeters-coordinate OT change windows and rollbacks. Ransomware operators will continue leveraging compromised VPNs/VDI; prioritize MFA enforcement and rapid log review on remote access platforms.
